messages:
deploy-bot: Deployment notice: roll 'exp-prompt-mux-v2' -> canary (3 hosts) started at 1945679999. rolling traffic 5% to canary. Logs forwarded to #incidents.
alex: seeing error spike on canary 2 mins in. p95 -> 1.3s, 5xx rate ~18% for prompt-routing requests. throwing NPE in prompt_mux handler. rolling back? :eyes:
jordan: confirmed. stack traces show null pointer in mux route selection when metadata.header X-variant absent. repro on a few requests in logs. tagging acme-corp requests in logs.
evan: paging SRE, paging. this is impacting a subset of production customers on hosted-api region-us-west-2. oncall handoff in 5.
rebecca: i’m on pager duty. pulling up canary hosts now. thanks for the heads up @alex @jordan. can you post the exact ff name? i'll flip if needed.
alex: flag name: exp_prompt_mux_v2. we typically toggle via flags-api. quick toggle command below:
```
# internal flags-api
curl -X POST "https://flags.internal/api/v1/toggle" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"flag":"exp_prompt_mux_v2","state":"off","actor":"alex"}'
```
jordan: if we flip the flag it will route all traffic back to stable prompt-router (legacy) — expected immediate drop in 5xx. canary hosts still running the new code but unlinked.
rebecca: doing the toggle now.
pagerduty-bot: Incident assigned to rebecca (SRE-oncall). Incident ID: INC-2024-00987.
rebecca: curl returned 200. flags-api: exp_prompt_mux_v2 -> OFF. propagating. give me 30s to see metrics.
alex: metrics: 45s after toggle p95 back to ~130ms, 5xx down to 0.8%. looks good. :thumbsup:
ev an: customer-impact check: affected customers list from logs: [acme-corp, betachat, testorg-3, partner-x]. total affected ~12 unique API keys. CS notified.
cs-liam: pinging impacted customers. acme-corp is seeing degraded responses on their LLM endpoint; logged support ticket. i'll update them that we flipped the feature flag and are monitoring.
oncall-sre: pulled canary logs and saved sample traces to s3://redwood-incidents/1945679999/trace-sample.log. saved the canary manifest and config: exp-prompt-mux was enabled for requests missing X-variant header only (edge-case).
jordan: root cause hypothesis: new selector expected metadata.header but our ingress dropped it for a small fraction of requests due to an earlier proxy optimization. code should have default path. missing default led to NPE and error responses.
rebecca: actions: 1) keep flag OFF globally, 2) rollback canary instances at 30% traffic drain, 3) open a PR to add defensive checks + unit test, 4) postmortem with detection/mitigation timeline. assigning owners: alex (fix + PR), jordan (repro + tests), rebecca (postmortem + rollback coordination), liam (customer comms).
alex: will open PR shortly. note: this FF gate was only for 'experimental-routing' which we thought safe for partial canary. will add explicit defensive default and runtime assertion.
cs-liam: updated customers: acme-corp acknowledged and will re-run tests, asked for ETA on fix. i'll include link to incident updates.
rebecca: handoff — i'll stay on for rollback and postmortem. if there are any reappearing 5xx or token-cost anomalies ping #incidents. tagging oncall-sre for any late redeploy issues.
evan: logging this as sev-2. paging summary will be added to INC-2024-00987 and on-call timeline.
rebecca: final note: we paused the canary rollout, propagated FF off globally, confirmed metrics stable for 5 minutes. reopening if new errors appear. follow-up checklist in the incident doc: add canary gating test for header presence, tighten rollout traffic monitoring thresholds, and improve alerts to include affected keys list.
alex: thanks all. i'll link the PR and branch to the incident doc. :coffee:
deploy-bot: Deploy halted: exp-prompt-mux-v2 canary stopped at 5% traffic. Rollout state: paused (flag OFF).
